title: Dilivygo provider manifest
description: Declarative metadata for one integration catalog entry. This file is the single source of truth for allowed fields and value sets; apps/server/lib/provider-manifest.js validates entries against it with a hand-rolled validator (no new dependencies). The current integrations/catalog.json must validate against this schema (proven by apps/server/tests/developer-platform.test.js).

type.description: native = first-party runtime code; nango = Nango-managed OAuth/proxy; webhook = signed outbound automation endpoint.

capabilities.description: Capability tags (e.g. payments, accounting, automation). Business code must depend on these, not on provider names.

integrationId.description: Nango Unique Key. REQUIRED when type is nango (enforced by the validator); must be absent-or-empty otherwise.

requiresProviderApproval.description: True for partner-gated providers that must never render Connected until approval + credentials exist.

auth.description: How credentials are onboarded for this provider.

type.description: managed = Nango holds secrets; oauth2 = direct OAuth; api-key = pasted key; none = no credentials (e.g. outbound webhook URL only).

requiredConfig.description: Config field names the operator must supply (never the secrets themselves).

regions.description: ISO region/country codes where the provider operates. Empty or absent = global.

docsUrl.description: Link to the provider runbook under docs/integrations/providers/ or the official vendor docs.

sandbox.description: Sandbox / test-fixture expectations for partner certification.

notes: Conditional rule (enforced by the hand-rolled validator, expressed here for readers): when `type` is `nango`, `integrationId` is required and non-empty.
